procedure.applicability: Official CORE One+ calibration / first run chapter. Existing task and firmware-profile choices remain unchanged.

ring.seatQualification: Authored installed reference from the existing holder groove, near local Z30mm. Retains the full3.5mm round section. The25.9mm installed opening is slightly larger than nominal25mm; it is not an OEM elastic/force measurement.

geometryInputs: Existing nativeCAD781 and785 rear locating pins

teachingRegistration.sheetRule: Support the whole rear edge while lowering. A pivot4mm forward at the inner notch would lower the rear tabs into the bed.
teachingRegistration.puck: Whole Puck registered from the four complete native panel holes and the unchanged Puck bore pattern. Digital reference measurements, not physical specimen metrology.
teachingRegistration.holder: Whole holder on the opposing mating axis, dock at CAD X126.00127500515106mm and holder origin CAD X190.00127500515092mm. Assembly, upgrade and maintenance share this registration.
teachingRegistration.lock: Clockwise as seen from outside(+X looking toward-X). Nominal quarter-turn demonstration; the official line does not prescribe an exact angle or torque.
teachingRegistration.unchanged: Complete source vertex/normal/index arrays and scales are preserved. Initial-setup offsets are relative to the corrected shared rest placement; ordinary task leave restores that same placement.
